verdict.result: 2/3 LIT, 1/3 CRASH under IDENTICAL U0 config (53f runtime, r17r JAR, fresh data each run) = NONDETERMINISTIC.
verdict.flaw_008: Zero variables changed across the 3 runs, yet the key flipped (lit -> crash -> lit). Per FLAW-008 this is nondeterminism, NOT a clean single-variable attribution. The outer-ring 'runtime 9e14->53f is the unique regression variable' hypothesis is REFUTED: a deterministic 53f regression would kill all 3; instead 53f lit antennapod 2/3.
verdict.gate_not_met: The dispatch's swap trigger was '3 次都死' (all 3 die). Run1 and Run3 are LIT (own UI self-read). Therefore the runtime swap 53f->9e14 is NOT triggered. FZ-003 (asset-fd, resident in 53f) was NOT touched.
verdict.true_first_fatal: The single crash (r2) is a RenderThread SIGSEGV(SEGV_MAPERR) AFTER first-frame — the SAME intermittent skia text/glyph RenderThread native wall documented for antennapod@61b in benchmark/2026-09-30-r17p-firstwall-diff (persisting_v3c_native_for_cx_t0: 'RenderThread skia TextBlobRedrawCoordinator SIGSEGV (fd-fitness@5ea, antennapod@61b)'). Owner: cx-t0 (v3c native render substrate), NOT the runtime asset-fd difference.
verdict.reconciliation: The U0 full-sweep 'AntennaPod lit->desktop' single observation was one unlucky draw of this pre-existing ~1/3 RenderThread SIGSEGV, mis-read as a runtime regression because runtime was the only KNOWN changed variable in that sweep. The controlled 3x repeat exposes the flakiness that a single sweep hides.

fz002_caveat: FZ-002 (bigstack provider) freeze evidence lists 'AntennaPod shows own UI at t20 in 5cd unified sweep'. That evidence is a single-draw observation of a ~2/3-lit flaky app; it is CONSISTENT with these results but antennapod is NOT a reliable freeze-evidence app on route-A boards due to the intermittent RenderThread SIGSEGV. FZ-002 still stands on its other evidence (Tusky/Markor/K-9/Auxio). Recommend outer ring not rely on antennapod alone for any freeze re-light gate.
